## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

Describe checks run, browsers tested, and any limitations. Include screenshots for
visual changes. Remove private text and recordings before attaching examples.

## Dependencies and rights

If this adds or adapts code, models or voices, link the source and licence and
retain the required notices. Original contributions use GPL-3.0-or-later.
